label: Agglomeration code
definition: Code of the agglomeration, as in the spatial points dataflow. Primary key. Its identifier scheme is always `euAgglomerationCode`, the only one used, so the scheme is not reported.
condition: Accepted code of an agglomeration of the country in {ref}`sp-agglomeration`

label: Status
definition: Status of the agglomeration at the reference year.

label: Expected load
definition: Expected generated load of the agglomeration at the expected date of compliance.

label: Expected load collected
definition: Expected percentage of the generated load collected through collecting systems at the expected date of compliance.

label: Expected load in individual systems
definition: Expected percentage of the generated load addressed through individual systems at the expected date of compliance.

label: Remarks
definition: Any relevant comment on the agglomeration.
